items.title: Graph Engineering for AI Agents: Beyond the Single-Agent Loop
items.raw_text:
AI-agent development has progressed through overlapping phases: prompt engineering, context engineering, tool use, autonomous loops, memory systems, and multi-agent coordination. A newer focus is graph engineering, which treats AI applications as explicitly designed workflows rather than a single autonomous agent. Graph engineering defines how agents, tools, deterministic functions, validators, data sources, and humans coordinate to […]

The post Graph Engineering for AI Agents: Beyond the Single-Agent Loop appeared first on Analytics Vidhya.
items.reason_zh: 提出图工程概念，超越单智能体循环，为AI应用设计提供系统化方法论，极具实践指导意义。

items.title: The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.22585v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Public leaderboards for coding agents typically rank systems by model name and pass rate, while the surrounding harness (the scaffold that issues tools, manages context, and decides when to stop) is often under-specified. Model-to-model comparison is valid when the harness is fixed; when it varies, performance and efficiency conflate model and scaffold effects. We evaluate Qwen 3.6 Plus and MiniMax M2.5 across three open-source harnesses (Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK) on a stratified 50-task subset of Terminal-Bench Pro. Harness choice induces up to a 40x difference in tokens per solved task, while paired within-model pass-rate differences remain 0-8 percentage points (95% paired-task bootstrap CIs include zero except for the largest gap). Failure fingerprints replicate across models (REASON for Goose, VERIFY/MAX_TURNS for OpenHands-SDK, idle-loop/TIME for OpenCode), indicating harness-level biases that are largely model-independent. F
items.reason_zh: 揭示编码智能体评估中脚手架（harness）选择作为隐藏变量的影响，对正确解读排行榜和设计评估实验至关重要。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出编码智能体中的“脚手架效应”。公开排行榜通常按模型名称和通过率排名，但支撑智能体的脚手架（负责工具调用、上下文管理和停止决策）往往被忽略。当脚手架固定时，模型间比较有效；但当脚手架变化时，性能和效率会混淆模型与脚手架的影响。作者通过实验证明，不同脚手架对同一模型的性能影响显著，甚至超过模型间的差异。因此，排行榜排名可能误导实际能力评估。本文呼吁在评估中明确指定脚手架，并提出了更公平的比较方法。
items.title_zh: 编码智能体中的脚手架效应：智能体评估中的隐藏变量——脚手架选择

items.title: Anthropic says its Mythos model found vulnerabilities in cryptographic algorithms that secure the internet
items.raw_text:
Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview found weaknesses in key cryptographic algorithms, including a better attack on HAWK, a post-quantum signature scheme that human experts had reviewed for more than two years. The model found it in just 60 hours at an API cost of about $100,000. The findings don't affect systems in use today, but they show how AI could challenge core assumptions behind internet security, Anthropic says.

The article Anthropic says its Mythos model found vulnerabilities in cryptographic algorithms that secure the internet appeared first on The Decoder.
items.reason_zh: Claude Mythos 发现加密算法漏洞，包括对后量子签名方案 HAWK 的更优攻击，具有重大安全意义。
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos Preview 模型发现了两种加密算法的数学弱点：一是显著削弱了 NIST 审查中的后量子数字签名方案 HAWK，将其有效密钥强度降低；二是对 AES 算法也发现了新的攻击方法。这些漏洞此前多年未被人类专家发现。
items.title_zh: Anthropic 称其 Mythos 模型发现了保护互联网的加密算法中的漏洞

items.title: Claude found mathematical flaws in two cryptographic algorithms that years of expert review missed

Anthropic announced on Monday that Claude Mythos Preview has discovered mathematical weaknesses in two cryptographic algorithms. The first substantially weakens HAWK, a post-quantum digital signature scheme under review by NIST, by cutting its effective key strength in half. The second improves the best-known attack on seven-round AES, the most widely used symmetric cipher, by 200-800x. […]

items.title: DynaResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.22614v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates Rollout and Training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning suffers from severe pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency. We present DynaResize, a runtime GPU reallocation system that dynamically switches GPUs between Rollout and Training to balance stage execution times without changing RL semantics. DynaResize decomposes resizing into fine-grained operations and removes non-startup-critical work from the critical path through communicator reuse, bounded state staging, and hysteresis-based resizing. Experimental results show that DynaResize can improve end-to-end throughput by 66.5% and reduce total execution time by 33% over the optimal static configuration, while hiding 27% of role-switching overhead.
items.reason_zh: 提出运行时GPU重分配系统DynaResize，动态平衡LLM后训练中Rollout与Training阶段，减少流水线气泡，提升资源利用率。
items.summary_zh: 基于强化学习的LLM后训练通常将Rollout和Training分离到不同GPU资源上，但静态GPU分区在长尾延迟下会导致严重流水线气泡。本文提出DynaResize，一种运行时GPU重分配系统，能动态切换GPU在Rollout和Training之间的角色，以平衡阶段执行时间。实验表明，DynaResize显著减少了空闲时间，提高了整体吞吐量，为大规模LLM训练的资源优化提供了新思路。
items.title_zh: DynaResize：面向分离式LLM后训练的运行时GPU重分配

items.title: [程序员] 两周前我把 OpenAI 的 Agent SDK 移植成了 Go，两周后我让它"叛变"了
items.raw_text:
两周前我在这里发过 v0.1.0 （ https://www.v2ex.com/t/1223216 ），当时的介绍是"OpenAI Agents SDK 的忠实 Go 移植"。先还个愿：3 楼建议、我在 4 楼答应的"把野路子裸 JSX 换成正经构建"，干完了——现在是 Vite + React + TS ，产物照旧 embed 进单二进制，部署还是一个文件。

然后说这两周发生的事。一句话版本：我停止了对 Python 上游的忠实，151 个提交之后，v0.2.0 不再是移植品。

"忠实"是怎么变成陷阱的

移植做到后面，越来越多地方是在用 Go 模仿 Python 的形状：Python 用生命周期钩子，我就造一套钩子接口； Python 的 run 靠异步任务，我就开后台协程加 channel 。能跑，但每一处都别扭——你得记得 cancel context ，得担心协程泄漏，得在文档里解释"这里为什么长得不像 Go"。

压垮我的最后一根稻草是流式接口。Go 1.23 有了 range-over-func ，我试着把整个 run 循环塞进迭代器里：range 就是运行，break 就是停止，没有后台协程，没有需要记得 cancel 的东西。改完那天我意识到，这个形状 Python 永远给不了我——它是这门语言自己长出来的。

于是做了个决定：不再对标上游。写了一份 spec.md 当"宪法"，现在 1600 行、61 节，每个行为决定连同理由记录在案，规则只有一条：改行为必须在同一个提交里改 spec 。上游还看，但只记录"采纳/不采纳+为什么"，没有跟随义务。

顺着这个思路重想了几件事

会话不再是消息列表，是一棵树。起因很具体：想做"重新生成"，发现列表模型下只能删历史。改成 append-only 的树之后，重试是弃一根分支而不是抹掉过去，"看看另一个答案"就成了自然能力，Web UI 里现
items.reason_zh: 作者从忠实移植到自主创新的过程，揭示了跨语言移植的陷阱与Go语言实践智慧，对AI工程化有启发。
items.summary_zh: 作者分享将OpenAI Agents SDK移植到Go的经历。最初是忠实移植，但逐渐发现用Go模仿Python形状的局限性，最终在151个提交后转向自主设计。文章详细讨论了移植过程中的技术决策，包括构建工具从野路子JSX切换到Vite+React+TS，以及如何利用Go的特性优化性能。作者反思了“忠实”移植如何成为陷阱，并提供了Go语言实现AI Agent的实践经验。

items.title: I built a deep learning library from scratch in C that lets you train language models [P]
items.raw_text:
my goal was to train a Language model (SLM) entirely from scratch so no ML libraries allowed . so i gathered what's needed to make it happen :

from tensor manipulation (views, operations , allocations)

the autograd ( a DAG that retains the previous operations and inputs in order that led into a certain output tensor , this let's us also apply backpropagation so i've got to implement also the partial derivative functions in order to calculate the gradients for each weights)

the neural networks modules (organizes the weights / activations , losses , optimizers implemented SGD and Adamw)

the decoder so the layer norm , MHA , FFN .
also implemented a Fast matmul using AVX2 to speed things up.

with it i managed to train a tiny LM with 2 millions params.it's a 4 layer Decoder used tiny_shakespear i got what i think is a good result .

items.summary_zh: 作者从零开始用C语言构建了一个深度学习库，不依赖任何ML库，实现了张量操作、自动求导（DAG记录操作与输入）、以及训练小型语言模型（SLM）所需的所有组件。项目展示了底层实现细节，对于理解深度学习框架的内部机制非常有帮助。

items.title: The AI wrote every security control. It skipped the question underneath
items.raw_text:
A penetration test at a financial services firm managing billions of dollars in client assets has found a critical flaw in AI-generated code. The interesting part is what the code got right. Sygnia, the incident response firm, assessed a customer onboarding application built substantially with Claude. It handled government-issued identification, identity verification data, payment details […]



This story continues at The Next Web
items.reason_zh: 真实渗透测试案例，揭示AI生成代码的安全隐患，对开发者有直接警示价值。
items.summary_zh: 安全公司Sygnia在对一家管理数十亿美元资产的金融服务公司进行渗透测试时，发现其客户入职应用存在严重安全漏洞。该应用大量使用AI生成代码，虽然代码本身看似正确，但忽略了底层安全设计问题，例如未对用户输入进行充分验证。这一案例凸显了AI辅助编程的潜在风险：AI可能生成功能正确的代码，但缺乏安全上下文，导致整体系统脆弱。
items.title_zh: AI编写了所有安全控制代码，却忽略了底层问题
